mapper.select: SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM company c LEFT JOIN division d ON c.company_code = d.company_code WHERE c.company_code = #{company_code} ORDER BY c.company_code, d.division_code

SELECT #{search_type} AS search_type, a.company_code AS company_code, a.company_name AS company_name, a.company_name_eng AS company_name_eng, a.company_name_loc AS company_name_loc, a.officer_name AS officer_name, a.officer_name_eng AS officer_name_eng, a.officer_phone_no AS officer_phone_no, a.officer_email AS officer_email, a.business_no AS business_no, a.com_phone_no AS com_phone_no, a.com_fax_no AS com_fax_no, a.zip_code AS zip_code, a.address AS address, a.address_eng AS address_eng, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.company_use_yn, ''), 'Y') AS company_use_yn, a.ctc_decision_only_yn AS ctc_decision_only_yn, a.co_certified_exporter_yn AS co_certified_exporter_yn, a.certification_type AS certification_type, a.certification_no AS certification_no, a.material_use_yn AS material_use_yn, a.basic_aging_period AS basic_aging_period, co_bf.option_value AS bf_company_option, co_ru.option_value AS ru_company_option
FROM company a LEFT OUTER JOIN company_option co_bf ON a.company_code = co_bf.company_code AND co_bf.option_code = 'BF' LEFT OUTER JOIN company_option co_ru ON a.company_code = co_ru.company_code AND co_ru.option_code = 'RU' WHERE a.company_code = #{company_code}

SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM division d WHERE d.company_code = #{company_code} and d.division_code = #{p_param_code} ORDER BY c.company_code, d.division_code
SELECT c.company_code AS target_code ,c.company_name AS target_name ,c.com_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,c.com_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM company c WHERE c.company_code = #{company_code}
SELECT d.division_code AS target_code ,d.division_name AS target_name ,d.div_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,d.div_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM division d WHERE d.company_code = #{company_code}
SELECT f.fta_code AS target_code ,f.fta_name AS target_name ,f.com_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,f.com_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM fta_master f WHERE f.company_code = #{company_code}
